definitions.gloss: outside the body; extracorporeal; external to the body
definitions.explanation: Referring to something that occurs or exists outside the body. Used primarily in medical and biological contexts.

examples.japanese: {体外|たいがい}{受精|じゅせい}で{子供|こども}を{授|さず}かった。
examples.english: They conceived a child through in vitro fertilization.

examples.japanese: {薬|くすり}の{体外|たいがい}への{排出|はいしゅつ}には{時間|じかん}がかかる。
examples.english: It takes time for the drug to be expelled from the body.

examples.japanese: {体外|たいがい}{式|しき}{除細動器|じょさいどうき}はAEDとも{呼|よ}ばれ、{公共|こうきょう}{施設|しせつ}に{設置|せっち}されている。
examples.english: External defibrillators, also called AEDs, are installed in public facilities.

notes: Composed of {体|たい} (body) + {外|がい} (outside). The opposite is {体内|たいない} (inside the body). Common collocations: {体外|たいがい}{受精|じゅせい} (in vitro fertilization / IVF), {体外|たいがい}{診断|しんだん} (in vitro diagnostics), {体外|たいがい}{式|しき} (external type). Not to be confused with the homophone {大概|たいがい} (generally; mostly; enough already). {体外|たいがい}{受精|じゅせい} is a widely discussed topic in Japan as the country grapples with declining birth rates — IVF treatment is now partially covered by health insurance.
